title: Bidirectional Native-Signal Transition-State Audit
question: Within the bidirectional US30 and US100 strategy books, does an admitted birth whose native direction persists from the immediately prior same-component signal have materially different 2x-cost stressed R and stop incidence from a birth whose native direction reverses?
hypothesis: Immediate same-component direction persistence and reversal are natural causal market-structure states. If one state represents a stable continuation or a productive regime turn, persistence-minus-reversal should show a material return/stop separation with coherent signs across periods and both component strategies inside the corresponding symbol book.
why_now: After Program 3 Unit 047 closed, the recent durable sequence is Programs 7, 5, 2, 4 and 3. Program 1 is the only active macro program absent from that sequence. Outcome-free reconstruction identifies a dense sequential direction state across both bidirectional symbol books without relaxing the rejected cross-strategy same-day signal proposal or reopening absolute signal strength.

macro_rotation.program_2: Unit 045 is closed invalid with no VIX repair or adjacent external context.
macro_rotation.program_3: Unit 047 just closed and no weekday, calendar or session successor may open.
macro_rotation.program_4: Unit 046 is closed invalid and no RC4 management repair or successor may open.
macro_rotation.program_5: Unit 044 is closed invalid and no nearby lot or risk-envelope work may open.

macro_rotation.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7. Do not open another signal-history length, streak, time-decay, magnitude, direction subgroup, symbol subgroup or Program 1 successor automatically.

distinction_from_closed_work.native_signal_strength_016: Unit 016 used absolute current SIGNAL_DECIDED.value_a magnitude. Unit 048 does not read or transform value_a and uses only the relation between two consecutive native direction values.
distinction_from_closed_work.native_direction_asymmetry_034: Unit 034 compared current BUY versus SELL. Unit 048 centers inside strategy-period cells and compares persistence versus reversal, so neither current direction can pass or fail by itself.
distinction_from_closed_work.same_strategy_interbirth_gap_035: Unit 035 measured elapsed time between admitted births. Unit 048 uses no elapsed threshold and lets skipped or expired signal opportunities update the immediately prior native direction state.
distinction_from_closed_work.rejected_same_day_prior_signal_breadth: The rejected proposal required two distinct earlier other-strategy signals on the same day and concentrated in Cross. Unit 048 uses exactly one prior signal from the same component, no day window and dense bidirectional symbol books.
distinction_from_closed_work.one_direction_exclusion: RC16 and Return emit only +1 native directions in this evidence, so their reversal state is structurally absent. They are reported as context and cannot pass, fail or rescue either bidirectional-book variant.

immutable_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only exact component identity, event ordering, SIGNAL_DECIDED.value_b direction, signal-to-birth linkage, fresh period and admitted birth identity were used. No close value, stressed R, stop association, transition-conditioned economics, gate or verdict was accessed.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not a primary event key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each fresh period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, SIGNAL_DECIDED-before-birth and close-before-birth precedence, then source path and line.
fixed_reconstruction.exact_component_selection: Use only the six complete component_id keys in strategy_identity. Prefix, suffix, substring, wildcard and inferred-family selectors are prohibited.
fixed_reconstruction.direction_state: SIGNAL_DECIDED.value_b must be exactly -1 or +1. Reset prior direction at each fresh-period boundary; every signal event, including a later skipped or expired opportunity, updates the component's immediately prior direction.
fixed_reconstruction.market_signal_link: Consume the latest same-component SIGNAL_DECIDED at the corresponding RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return OPEN; it must precede OPEN by no more than 2.1 minutes.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_signal_link: Consume the same-time latest Passive SIGNAL_DECIDED at PASSIVE_PLACE; PASSIVE_FILL begins the lifecycle with that placement's transition state and PASSIVE_EXPIRE creates no lifecycle.

transition_roles.FIRST_OBSERVED_SIGNAL: No earlier same-component signal exists inside the fresh period.
transition_roles.SAME_DIRECTION_PERSISTENCE: Current direction equals the immediately prior same-component signal direction.
transition_roles.OPPOSITE_DIRECTION_REVERSAL: Current direction is the opposite of the immediately prior same-component signal direction.

fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle: OPEN or admitted PASSIVE_FILL begins one lifecycle with positive planned risk; CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends it, value_b is 2x-cost stressed net USD and EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop-loss exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Close value_b divided by positive birth planned risk.
fixed_reconstruction.strategy_period_centering: Within each of the 16 bidirectional strategy x P1-P4 cells, subtract the full-cell mean stressed R and stop rate from every persistence or reversal lifecycle before book aggregation. FIRST_OBSERVED_SIGNAL is included in the full-cell mean but excluded from the contrast.

fixed_metrics.context_report: Report all six strategy relation counts and raw economics, including structurally one-direction RC16/Return and FIRST_OBSERVED_SIGNAL, without allowing them to pass or rescue.
fixed_metrics.variant_contrast: For each symbol book report persistence-minus-reversal mean centered stressed R and centered stop, four period effects and two component-strategy effects.
fixed_metrics.period_contribution_share: Absolute period contrast numerator divided by the sum of absolute four-period contrast numerators.
fixed_metrics.strategy_contribution_share: Absolute component-strategy contrast numerator divided by the sum of absolute two-strategy contrast numerators.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six event files retain their exact byte lengths and hashes, contain 16,477 rows and zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reconstruct exactly 2,429 SIGNAL_DECIDED events, 81 overwritten unconsumed latest signals, two unconsumed latest signals at period ends and zero signal-direction or birth-link fault.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles with strategy totals 272/206/805/118/238/594, 407.0477 USD 2x stressed net and 206 stop exits with zero overlap, pending, risk or close fault.
Reproduce every frozen relation, period, strategy, book and book-period density, including exact zero reversal for RC16 and Return.
Reconstruct exactly 16 finite bidirectional strategy-period centering cells.

density: Reproduce exact frozen book and book-period persistence/reversal counts.
Persistence and reversal each contain at least 150 pooled lifecycles and at least 27 in every period.
Each component strategy has at least 50 persistence and 50 reversal lifecycles pooled.
Every component strategy-period cell has at least eight persistence and eight reversal lifecycles.
information: Absolute persistence-minus-reversal centered stressed-R difference is at least 0.10R.
Absolute persistence-minus-reversal centered stop difference is at least 0.05.
The pooled channels are economically concordant: positive R requires negative stop difference, while negative R requires positive stop difference.
Return and stop differences each share their pooled sign in at least three of four periods.
Return and stop differences each share their pooled sign in both component strategies.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one component strategy more than 65% of the absolute centered-R contrast numerator.
fixed_variant_gates.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every density and information requirement passes. Zero is never counted as a sign.

fixed_bundle_gate.authority_limit: Consumed-data association only. A pass selects no entry filter, signal change, direction rule, size, priority, EA or Live action and cannot open an adjacent successor automatically.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before reading transition-conditioned close value, stressed R, stop association, centered effect, gate or verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the six immutable files using complete component identities.
Do not alter history length, reset rule, transition roles, books, centering, metrics, density or information gates.
Do not add streak length, time decay, same-day window, signal magnitude, signed-current-direction subgroup, strategy-only subset, RC16/Return reinterpretation or alternate symbol book.
Do not modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, inspect Program 6, retain a CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close after one result and return to whole-map comparison without adjacent Program 1 signal work.
